title: Ines and the Letter
author: Zephyrine Almeida
blurb: Felix Lockridge, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
